queries.query: Aomori City official cadastral map parcel GIS public map
queries.result: Found the official Aomori City geographic information service page linking to the public Aomapp viewer. The viewer is described as providing online geographic information; configuration inspection exposed a KIBANCHIZU (cadastral map) raster layer, but no anonymous vector parcel endpoint.
